title: 4-Day Yellowstone National Park, Mount Rushmore, Devil's Tower From Denver
includes: Pick-up and drop-off at designated hotels
Hotel for 3 Nights (2 or 3 people per room, 2 beds)
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
Children over 3 years old can participate. If you have children under 8 years old, please let us know their ages and the number of participants.
policies: Pick-up time and details of meeting place will be informed after your booking is confirmed.
This tour will depart from Denver (hotel near the airport) and return to Salt Lake City (hotel in downtown). Airport pick-up and drop-off are not possible due to licensing restrictions.
The itinerary may change depending on the weather and congestion on the day. There is no refund in that case.
The size of luggage that can be brought into the vehicle is limited to carry-on size, one piece per person.
It is recommended that you arrive in Denver at least one day before the tour.
On the last day of the tour, we will drop you off at a hotel in Salt Lake City (downtown). Please note that due to traffic and weather conditions, your arrival time in Salt Lake may be delayed.
The order of the tour itinerary may be reversed during peak season or due to weather conditions.
Changes in the date or number of people on the tour will also be subject to the cancellation policy.
Dual-language guiding (English and Japanese) may be provided depending on the participants.
cancellation:
If you cancel at least 6 full day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a full refund.
If you cancel between 2 and 6 day(s) before the scheduled departure time, you will receive a 50% refund.
If you cancel within 2 day(s) of the scheduled departure, you will receive a 0% refund.
blurb: Yellowstone National Park is a place that everyone wants to visit at least once. Yellowstone National Park is the first national park in the world. We will also take you to Mount Rushmore National Memorial, the symbol of the United States. We will also visit Devils Tower National Monument, the first national monument in the U.S., and Grand Teton National Park with its beautiful mountain scenery to complete the tour. This tour has a lot to offer, and we have enough time for you to spend in each place. We are sure you will be satisfied with this tour.
